entries.text: You see a seedy-looking Mexican man with slick hair.
entries.source_text: You see a seedy-looking Mexican man with slick hair.

entries.text: You see Hernandez, the rascally gambler.
entries.source_text: You see Hernandez, the rascally gambler.

entries.text: Oye, muchacho, allow me to introduce myself. I am Hernandez, a man of mucho gusto! You look like you are new here. Please, allow me to be your informant to the casino.
entries.source_text:
Oye, muchacho, allow me to introduce myself. I am Hernandez,
 a man of mucho gusto! You look like you are new here. Please,
 allow me to be your informant to the casino.

entries.text: Can you tell me about the casino?
entries.source_text: Can you tell me about the casino?

entries.text: No, thanks.
entries.source_text: No, thanks.

entries.text: Bloo?
entries.source_text: Bloo?

entries.text: But of course! This fine establishment is run by the famous Gizmo. A true visionary and a very wealthy man.
entries.source_text:
But of course! This fine establishment is run by
 the famous Gizmo. A true visionary and a very wealthy
 man.

entries.text: Thanks.
entries.source_text: Thanks.

entries.text: You say Gizmo is a visionary. What's his vision?
entries.source_text: You say Gizmo is a visionary. What's his vision?

entries.text: What are the odds like on the games here?
entries.source_text: What are the odds like on the games here?

entries.text: My friend, I hate to impose, but perhaps you could assist me. I have developed a sure-fire system, because I have discovered how Gizmo runs his tables, but I do not have the caps to play.
entries.source_text:
My friend, I hate to impose, but perhaps you could assist me.
 I have developed a sure-fire system, because I have discovered
 how Gizmo runs his tables, but I do not have the caps to
 play.

entries.text: [You get the feeling that he's trying to scam you.]
entries.source_text: [You get the feeling that he's trying to scam you.]

entries.text: Perhaps you can spare a few caps? I guarantee success.
entries.source_text: Perhaps you can spare a few caps? I guarantee success.

entries.text: Sure, sounds good.
entries.source_text: Sure, sounds good.

entries.text: No, thanks.
entries.source_text: No, thanks.

entries.text: I think you're lying. You're trying to scam me.
entries.source_text: I think you're lying. You're trying to scam me.

entries.text: Sorry, mi amigo. Hey, let me show you a neat game . . .
entries.source_text: Sorry, mi amigo. Hey, let me show you a neat game . . .

entries.text: Thank you very much, mi amigo! In a few days I shall be able to pay you back, with interest. My system is slow, you see, it requires much patience, but it will most certainly reap great profits!
entries.source_text:
Thank you very much, mi amigo! In a few days I shall be able
 to pay you back, with interest. My system is slow, you see,
 it requires much patience, but it will most certainly reap
 great profits!

entries.text: Very well, but I guarantee success! If you want to get in on the riches just waiting, come back soon, or I will find another partner!
entries.source_text:
Very well, but I guarantee success! If you want to get in

 another partner!

entries.text: My friend, I see you are a man of much taste, as well. Perhaps a simple game of dice?
entries.source_text:
My friend, I see you are a man of much taste, as well.
 Perhaps a simple game of dice?

entries.text: All right!
entries.source_text: All right!

entries.text: No, thanks, I'd rather try something else.
entries.source_text: No, thanks, I'd rather try something else.

entries.text: Gizmo had a dream of setting up a place where people could meet and enjoy themselves. He had the ambition to make it happen. The result is the casino you see here.
entries.source_text:
Gizmo had a dream of setting up a place where people
 could meet and enjoy themselves. He had the ambition to
 make it happen. The result is the casino you see here.

entries.text: He gives people a chance to shrug off their cares in the broken world outside. And he brings money into Junktown!
entries.source_text:
He gives people a chance to shrug off their cares in the
 broken world outside. And he brings money into Junktown!

entries.text: Sounds like a good idea.
entries.source_text: Sounds like a good idea.

entries.text: Life's hard enough. I don't trust the motives of someone who would encourage people to lose their money.
entries.source_text:
Life's hard enough. I don't trust the motives of someone

entries.text: You obviously don't share Gizmo's brilliance. This place is a respite from the harshness of everyday life.
entries.source_text:
You obviously don't share Gizmo's brilliance. This place
 is a respite from the harshness of everyday life.

entries.text: Well, Gizmo runs a pretty good house, although the games are, how shall we say, rather weighted towards the house. It's not like his dealers cheat, though. But unless you have a system, like me, you will need to be very clever.
entries.source_text:

entries.text: Thanks.
entries.source_text: Thanks.

entries.text: How is your system coming?
entries.source_text: How is your system coming?

entries.text: Nothing, thanks.
entries.source_text: Nothing, thanks.

entries.text: My system is developing slowly. I have living expenses and such, you know, but it is working!
entries.source_text:

entries.text: That's great!
entries.source_text: That's great!

entries.text: I think that you are a liar and a cheat. Where's my money?
entries.source_text: I think that you are a liar and a cheat. Where's my money?

entries.text: So, you think you have tumbled to me, eh? Well, you won't get anything from me!
entries.source_text:

entries.text: Buenos dias, my friend! What can I do for you today?
